summary: SWE.3 trace schema permits one owning unit per delivered function, but the required GPDMA1 and ADC12 units share all five bus functions. Unique seed rows tracing both units trigger CODE:SPEC_OF_OTHER_UNIT; duplicate rows violate the explicit once-per-function contract. Support shared unit ownership in the trace validator/schema.
